name: Color Sorting Toy
description: Introducing our Color Sorting toy IQ Brain Teaser Game, a captivating activity that enhances cognitive skills while providing hours of fun! In this engaging game, players choose a card and observe its pattern before moving colorful wooden blocks to match it. The first person to replicate the card’s design wins, making it a delightful challenge for all ages. This toy is also an excellent tool for occupational therapy, making it a must-have in preschool classrooms.Designed with early development in mind, this Montessori-inspired toy helps toddlers recognize colors and improve their observation, logic, hand-eye coordination, and fine motor skills.This wooden sliding puzzle is suitable for outdoor play, school activities, or family bonding time. Let the learning and fun begin!
